description: Add BACK button to Makima AI password gate, add HINTER MT menu item to dashboard, enhance system prompt for coding capabilities, and add safety boundaries
steps: STEP 1 - Add BACK button to password gate in static/js/makima-ai.js: In the _renderPasswordGate() function (line 224), add a back button BEFORE the makima-password-modal div, inside makima-password-gate. The button text should be '← KEMBALI'. On click, it should call showMainView() (already defined globally in ui.js at line 287). The button HTML: '<button class="makima-back-btn" onclick="showMainView()">← KEMBALI</button>'. Place it as the first child inside makima-password-gate, before the modal div.

STEP 2 - Add CSS styles for the back button in static/css/makima-ai.css: Add styles for .makima-back-btn after the PASSWORD GATE section (after line ~1240). Style: position absolute top-left of the gate, dark glass background (rgba(12,4,4,0.8)), border 1px solid rgba(204,0,0,0.3), border-radius 10px, padding 10px 18px, color white, font-family var(--font-ui), font-size 0.75rem, letter-spacing 1.5px, cursor pointer, transition for border and box-shadow. On hover: border-color var(--red), box-shadow 0 0 12px rgba(204,0,0,0.3). Position: top 24px, left 24px, z-index 10.

STEP 3 - Add HINTER MT menu item in templates/index.html: After the MAKIMA AI drawer-item (the one with data-view="makima-ai"), add a new drawer-item with data-view="hinter-mt" and data-feature="hinter-mt". Use a terminal/code SVG icon. Text: 'HINTER MT'. Badge: soon-badge with text 'SOON'.

STEP 4 - Register HINTER MT in the featureMap in static/js/ui.js: Add 'hinter-mt' to the featureMap object (around line 308) with title 'HINTER MT' and description 'HINTER MT belum tersedia.' Also add 'hinter-mt' to the viewConfig object with type 'coming-soon', title 'HINTER MT', badge 'SOON', description 'HINTER MT belum tersedia.'

STEP 5 - Enhance system prompt in app.py: Replace the _MAKIMA_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION string (lines 26-47) with an enhanced version that includes coding capabilities. Keep ALL existing rules about browsing, images, URL, etc. ADD new coding persona rules: Makima can help with HTML/CSS/JS/Python/Flask/Node.js, UI/UX, bug fixing, deploy Railway/GitHub, API integration, frontend/backend. Coding style: direct solutions, clean/rapi, short explanations, provide ready-to-use code, separate by file if long, use bahasa Indonesia natural, use 'kamu' not 'Anda'. Add safety rules: reject malware/phishing/token stealing/hack/spam/bypass payment/data theft/system damage requests with the response 'Aku tidak bisa bantu membuat itu. Tapi aku bisa bantu buat versi aman, edukasi, atau proteksinya.' then offer safe alternatives. Add code formatting rules: 1-2 sentence explanation first, code in markdown code blocks, label filenames if multiple files.
acceptance_criteria: Password gate shows a BACK button with text '← KEMBALI' positioned at the top-left
Clicking the BACK button returns to the downloader/main view without resetting the app or calling AI API
HINTER MT appears in the side drawer after MAKIMA AI with a 'SOON' badge
Clicking HINTER MT shows a coming-soon message 'HINTER MT belum tersedia.' without errors
System prompt in app.py includes coding capabilities and safety boundaries
No TikTok downloader logic is modified
verification: Run: python -c "import app" to confirm no syntax errors in app.py
Run: python -c "from app import _MAKIMA_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION; assert 'coding' in _MAKIMA_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION.lower() or 'kode' in _MAKIMA_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION.lower()" to verify coding prompt is present
Run: grep -c 'HINTER MT' templates/index.html to confirm menu item exists
Run: grep -c 'hinter-mt' static/js/ui.js to confirm feature registration
Run: grep -c 'makima-back-btn' static/js/makima-ai.js to confirm back button exists
Run: grep -c 'makima-back-btn' static/css/makima-ai.css to confirm back button styles exist
findings: All 5 steps implemented successfully. app.py imports without errors. All verifications pass. Used python3 instead of python (pyenv default not set).
